split.decision: Independent operator-materialized validation and hidden-test simulation streams; each contains 500 replications at n=1000. Quantile observations stored losslessly as truncated-normal distribution descriptors. No simulation seed in input.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 2 univariate Wasserstein n=1000; historical reproduction 0.12467381, paper derived mean 0.11794972. These paper values use the authors' proxy curves; the task's population curves were corrected on 2026-11-05.

allowed_changes: Distribution regression, nuisance modeling, fitting losses, transport estimation and numerical solvers may change while estimating the same geodesic GATT.
